events.quote: Bohemond declined to meet the papal legate , stating that the patriarchs of Antioch and Jerusalem had excommunicated him for his debate with the Hospitallers .

events.text: Gaetani mediated a reconciliation between Bohemond and the Hospitallers.

events.text: Bohemond sought refuge in the citadel.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Surprised by the coup , Bohemond sought refuge in the citadel .

events.text: Bohemond was able to muster his troops and defeat his enemies.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Although Leo of Cilicia also entered the town , Bohemond was able to muster his troops and defeat his enemies .

events.text: Bohemond captured and imprisoned the Latin patriarch.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He captured and imprisoned the Latin patriarch who refused to acknowledge him as the lawful prince .

events.text: Al-Adil broke into the County of Tripoli, forcing Bohemond to pay a compensation.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Al-Adil broke into the County of Tripoli , forcing Bohemond to pay a compensation in 1208 or 1209 .

events.text: Bohemond expelled the Eastern Orthodox patriarch from Antioch, allowing Peter of Ivrea to take charge of his see.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Bohemond expelled the Eastern Orthodox patriarch from Antioch , allowing Peter of Ivrea to take charge of his see .

events.text: A group of Assassins murdered Bohemonds eldest son, Raymond.
events.subject: self
events.quote: A group of Assassins murdered Bohemonds eldest son , Raymond , in 1213 .

events.text: Raymond-Roupen was installed as prince.
events.subject: other
events.quote: The Templars abandoned the citadel without resistance and Raymond-Roupen was installed as prince .

events.text: Duke Leopold VI of Austria invited Bohemond to join the Fifth Crusade.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Duke Leopold VI of Austria , who landed at Acre in late summer 1217 , invited Bohemond to join the Fifth Crusade .

events.text: Bohemond and his vassals marched to Acre.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Bohemond and his vassals marched to Acre .

events.text: Bohemond left the Kingdom of Jerusalem together with Andrew II of Hungary and Hugh I of Cyprus in January 1218.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Bohemond left the Kingdom of Jerusalem together with Andrew II of Hungary and Hugh I of Cyprus in January 1218 .

events.text: Andrew attended at the wedding of Bohemond and Hughs half-sister Melisende in Tripoli.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Andrew attended at the wedding of Bohemond and Hughs half-sister Melisende in Tripoli .

events.text: During the same year, Moslem troops made a plundering raid against the County of Tripoli.

events.subject: self
events.quote: Bohemond hurried to Antioch and seized the principality .

events.text: Bohemond granted Jabala to the Templars.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Before long , Bohemond granted Jabala ( which was still to be conquered ) to the Templars although Raymond-Roupen had promised the town to the Hospitallers .

events.text: Bohemond accepted the offer.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Bohemond accepted the offer and his son married Isabella in June 1222 .

events.text: His son married Isabella.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: Bohemond accepted the offer and his son married Isabella in June 1222 .

events.text: Philip and his supporters were captured and imprisoned.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: Philip and his supporters were captured and imprisoned at the end of 1224 .

events.text: Bohemond joined Frederick while Frederick was marching from Limassol to Nicosia.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Bohemond joined him while Frederick was marching from Limassol to Nicosia in August 1228 .

events.text: Frederick demanded an oath of fealty for Antioch and Tripoli from Bohemond.
events.subject: self
events.object: oath of fealty for Antioch and Tripoli
events.quote: Frederick demanded an oath of fealty for Antioch and Tripoli from Bohemond , but Bohemond feigned a nervous breakdown and returned to Nephin .

events.quote: Frederick demanded an oath of fealty for Antioch and Tripoli from Bohemond , but Bohemond feigned a nervous breakdown and returned to Nephin .

events.text: Bohemond again met Frederick in Acre.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Bohemond again met Frederick in Acre in 1229

events.text: Pope Gregory IX repeated the excommunication of Bohemond.
events.subject: self
events.quote: At the Hospitallers request , Pope Gregory IX repeated the excommunication of Bohemond in March 1230 .

events.text: Bohemond and the Hospitallers made a treaty.
events.subject: self
events.quote: With the mediation of Gerald and the Ibelins , Bohemond and the Hospitallers made a treaty which was signed on 26 October 1231 .

events.text: Bohemond confirmed the Hospitallers right to hold Jabala and granted them money fiefs in Tripoli and Antioch.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Bohemond confirmed the Hospitallers right to hold Jabala and a nearby fortress and granted them money fiefs in both Tripoli and Antioch .

events.text: Gerald of Lausanne lifted the excommunication.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Before long , Gerald of Lausanne lifted the excommunication and sent the treaty to Rome to be confirmed by the Holy See .

events.text: Bohemond died.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Bohemond died in March 1233 , a few weeks before the popes confirmation of his treaty with the Hospitallers came to Tripoli .
